traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- File-Level Template: `ensureFileSupportsAnnotation` + `buildSupportsTemplateComment` and `insertSupportsTemplate` automatically insert a file-level `@supports` JSDoc with clear placeholder story path and REQ IDs, including a TODO line explaining what to fill in. Behavior is tested in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts under the [REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE] case. - Format Fixes: `normalizeReqPrefixInDescription` and `handleItOrTestCall` implement normalization for malformed `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes (spacing, underscores, parentheses, and casing). Tests cover each malformed pattern and confirm the corrected outputs (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT). - Template Quality & Placeholders: The default template uses `docs/stories/XXX.X-STORY-NAME.story.md REQ-XXX-YYY REQ-XXX-ZZZ` plus an explicit TODO line, clearly indicating that developers must replace placeholders with real values (REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER). - Quality & Safety: Auto-fix logic only touches comments and string literals, never modifies test implementation code, and only applies fixes when a REQ ID is already present and pattern-matched. When there is no recognizable REQ prefix, the rule reports an error without a fixer (REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE). - Integration: The rule is marked fixable, wired into the ESLint visitor, and is exercised via RuleTester and the Jest test suite, demonstrating that it works correctly with ESLint --fix and existing validation logic. - User Experience: Templates and normalized prefixes are consistent, simple to understand, and accompanied by TODO guidance. Tests validate both behavior and non-interference with already-correct cases. - Documentation: The user docs (user-docs/api-reference.md) explicitly describe the auto-fix behavior and corresponding options, satisfying the Documentation acceptance criterion.
Given the concrete implementation, comprehensive tests that pass, and aligned documentation, the story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented and passes all specified acceptance criteria.
